title: PROBING CLASSIFIERS ARE UNRELIABLE FOR CONCEPT REMOVAL AND DETECTION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Spuriousness Score on the Twitter-PAN16 dataset to measure whether a model's latent representation still relies on the author's gender for main task predictions after applying concept removal methods like Null-Space Projection (INLP) and Adversarial Removal.

Evaluating the Spuriousness Score on the Twitter-AAE dataset to measure if sentiment classifiers still rely on dialect (African American English vs. Standard American English as a proxy for race) after applying concept removal methods.

Measuring the reliance of classifiers on non-task-relevant linguistic artifacts, such as the presence of negation words in natural language inference (MultiNLI dataset) or sentence length (Synthetic dataset), before and after applying concept removal techniques.
